title: AI-to-AI Communication: Toward a New Paradigm of Intelligence Search
summary: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has transformed the way people search for and interact with information. Traditional search engines primarily retrieve documents, web pages, and other information sources, while modern large language models can interpret questions, reason over information, and generate answers. This paper explores a possible next step: a search paradigm in which artificial intelligence systems communicate with other AI systems to search for, compare, evaluate, and synthesize answers.The paper introduces the concept of AI-to-AI Communication for Intelligence…

review.reason: Proposes AI-to-AI communication as a paradigm for searching, comparing, and synthesizing answers.
